principle: A corporate action normalizes a canonical series only with an independent, dated, effective statement (SEC 8-K/6-K or FINRA Daily List) that the price shows, plus a second confirmation independent of the triggering statement. Price alone never repairs (HOLD). Validation-only sources never enter the core.

sources.role: CORE_EVIDENCE (unchanged from v2, extraction rules unchanged)
eventTypes: stock dividend >= 25 % worded as a split
sources.ratio: exact ratio from the filing text (ranges never a ratio)
sources.effectiveDate: stated effective date / first split-adjusted session (8-K Item 3.03/5.03)
sources.publicationDate: EFTS file_date (visibleAt); EDGAR acceptance time from data.sec.gov/submissions for the PIT oracle
sources.pitSuitability: YES (per-observation filing date; acceptance-time check in protocol 3.0.0)
sources.identity: issuer CIK of the capture, price concordance on the stated session
failureModes: events announced then abandoned (only EFFECTIVE wording counts)
coverage starts with the full-text search (2001)
sources.licence: public domain (17 CFR 200.80); SEC fair-access policy respected (declared User-Agent, <= 8.9 requests/s across four parts)

sources.role: CORE_EVIDENCE (new in 3.0.0; second independent source, priority 2 of the request)
sources.access: https://api.finra.org/data/group/otcMarket/name/otcDailyList (FINRA Query API, public dataset, no credentials; POST with calendarDay ranges, 2,500 rows per page, record-total checked per window)
eventTypes: market-center change (exchange delisting to OTC, OTC to exchange listing)
deletion, bankruptcy flag, merger/acquisition, liquidation, 12(j) revocation
sources.ratio: 'new:old' rates in the row (e.g. reverseSplitRate '1:10' -> 0.1 new per old)
sources.effectiveDate: exDate (first session on the adjusted basis)
sources.publicationDate: dailyListDatetime (time the Daily List row was published); corrections (DC) and cancellations (DD) count only from their own publication
sources.pitSuitability: YES for timing by its own timestamp; a single timestamp per row, so FINRA timing is checked by truncation only (no second clock)
sources.identity: symbol (old or new) inside the listing window +- 7 days and a non-contradicting security description (token match with the company name where known); no CIK
sources.coverage: OTC equity securities, rows from mid-2018 (one 2016 row). Exchange-listed securities appear only at the transition into or out of OTC trading; exchange-listed splits are not on the list.
failureModes: exchange-listed universe mostly outside FINRA's scope
symbol reuse after years (window + name check)
OTC temporary symbols with a fifth letter D after reverse splits (newSymbolCode) not matching the exchange ticker
corrections that move the ex-date (grouped as one event, latest row wins)
API row cap per response (paged, totals checked)
sources.licence: FINRA public data via the Query API; terms permit retrieval; redistribution/commercial display not reviewed (LICENSE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, as in docs/VU_FREE_DATA_SOURCE_MAP.md for FINRA files). Used here only as evidence inside the canonical contract; no FINRA row is published.

sources.role: VALIDATION_ONLY (labels, PIT-independent; never a core input)
sources.access: query2.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart (split events, split-adjusted daily closes); paced 0.65 s per symbol from the runner
sources.pitSuitability: NO - therefore only a label/validation source
sources.identity: ticker; accepted only when vendor and provider daily raw returns agree within 1 % on >= 90 % of >= 60 common days
sources.coverage: currently listed symbols; delisted symbols mostly absent (survivor bias in the labels, measured per category)
failureModes: rate limiting / blocking of cloud IPs
shared upstream with the provider (a split missed by both looks like a genuine move -> counted as FALSE_POSITIVE of a hold, conservative)
sources.licence: no commercial licence; research reading only, nothing redistributed; per-ticker data stay in the runner and leave it only sealed

sources.role: VALIDATION (labels, as protocol 2.0.0) and core corroboration (blanked as label where it corroborated)

sources.pitSuitability: authoritative acceptance time (converted to US/Eastern day)

consideredNotIntegrated.reason: exchange notice with history requires a Nasdaq Trader subscription; nasdaqtrader.com daily list paths return 404 without it
api.nasdaq.com/api/calendar/splits returns only the current window (the date parameter is ignored); no history. Usable only as a forward-only collector for future PIT capture.
no bulk access; mass scraping of IR pages excluded (docs/VU_FREE_DATA_SOURCE_MAP.md); issuer press releases are already read when filed as 8-K EX-99
keys exist as repository secrets but free tiers (e.g. FMP 250 requests/day) cannot cover ~9,400 segments and the licence is LICENSE_UNKNOWN (docs/VU_FREE_DATA_SOURCE_MAP.md)
the provider under test, not independent

independence.labelSourceNotValidationSource: every label blanks the channels (FINRA, SEC share count) that appear in the sources of the decision it scores; vendor first for NORMALIZE
independence.note: FINRA is a core input, so FINRA- and share-count-based events are reported but do not gate the false-negative rate; the second vendor is the engine-independent source.
